data.body: Lane f041, 2026-10-20: plan review PASS (certified at fda55e3655e); claimed. Implemented as ca042ec0f49 on origin/main fda55e3655e: ADR 0120 (docs/adr/0120-cli-verb-consolidation.md plus the .numbers/0120 marker), the release-notes BREAKING entry and the CHANGELOG Unreleased entry (both list exactly the 20 pairs of _REMOVED_SPELLINGS minus the 5 bridge aliases, checked by script), the api-stability CLI row and removal-window sentence, and the regenerated ADR index. check_adr_numbers.py and gen_adr_index.py --check pass. The residual grep prints 0 lines. `rebar explain plan` output contains neither clarity-check nor check-ac (subprocess, rc 0). Pushed as Gerrit 3058 (ready, hashtag rebar-session-lane-e045) before the local make verify finished; that verify is running with PYPANDOC_PANDOC set to pandoc 3.9 and its result will be recorded here.
